formal_name: CUBE-REV Generation VII G7-P17-P0 — Untouched-Fresh Contact-Budget Planning, Stage-Held-Out Solve-Clustered Representation-Margin Reconstruction, 16-Cell Balance-Compatible Sample-Size Ladder, Conservative Bootstrap Assurance, Prior-Contact Exclusion Accounting & Minimal Confirmation Contact Audit
balance_constraint: 2 method ×2 reconstructor-band ×4 era =16 cells; candidate N must divide evenly across 16 cells

planning_evidence.statistic: per-solve held-out mean NLL difference HANDCRAFTED_SEARCH minus RAW_LATENT
planning_evidence.stage_models: leave-one-stage-out, same rank-8 model family and optimizer as R3
planning_evidence.bootstrap_scheme: stage-stratified resampling preserving development stage proportions

selection_rule.if_none: choose 96 as predeclared contact-budget ceiling and mark ASSURANCE_NOT_REACHED_AT_CEILING

secondary_planning: expected face-next state count from development states-per-solve distribution
forbidden: use any P17 body data in planning
choose N after P17 selection/body contact
treat bootstrap assurance as inferential proof
prior_contact_rule: P17 selector must independently reconstruct and exclude every body-contacted source ID through P15, including replay-invalid original IDs and all replacements; P16 added zero contact.
